title: 第一卷 第27章 黑色真丝浴袍
content_zh:
童喻看着手机，没有信息。

    可能，是还没有走。

    她坐在床尾，双手撑在两侧，轻轻地晃着腿。

    身上还穿着那件黑色真丝浴袍。

    她低着头，头发就自然垂落在肩膀两侧。

    门开了。

    童喻抬头。

    霍放反手把门关上，目光触及到童喻有些欣喜的眼睛。

    “走了吗？”童喻问。

    霍放脱掉了衣服。

    童喻睁大了眼睛，这么直接？

    他走到衣帽间，拿出一件黑色的衬衣，重新穿上。

    “晚一点出去。”霍放走到她面前，“帮我扣上。”

    童喻望着他没动。

    霍放也不急，“他们在外面等我。”

    童喻闻言立刻站起来，抬手帮他扣着扣子。

    霍放情不自禁地靠近她，跟赵亦可靠近他时的感觉完全不一样。

    刚才在外面，他脑子里想了她很多遍。

    童喻听着他的呼吸声，都穿着衣服，却有种彼此在散发着热气的错觉。

    “好了。”

    童喻退不了，后面就是床。

    霍放抬手轻抚她的脸，“等我。”

    童喻没答应，也没有说不等。

    霍放再一次走出卧室，这一次门没有关紧，他故意留着缝的。

    “走了。”

    童喻不知道他是在跟她说，还是在跟外面的人说。

    直到听见外面的门关上的提示音，她才知道，他们走了。

    童喻走出去，空旷的房子这会儿显得很冷清。

    她有点饿，这里不熟，她也没有随便翻找。

    走进洗手间，她在找她的衣服。

    脏衣篓里没有，她不信家里有人，他还能把她的衣服拿出这个地方。

    果然，在洗衣机里看到了。

    她赶紧拿出来，穿上，赶紧出门。

    进来难，出去倒是顺畅。

    这里离她住的地方有点远，她在外面随便吃了点东西就打车回了家。
content_en:
Tong Yu looked at his phone, but there was no message.

    Maybe, he hasn't left yet.

    She sat on the end of the bed, with her hands on her sides and her legs swaying slightly.

    She was still wearing the black silk bathrobe.

    She lowered her head, and her hair fell naturally on both sides of her shoulders.

    The door opened.

    Tong Yu raised his head.

    Huo Fang closed the door with his backhand, and his eyes met Tong Yu's somewhat delighted eyes.

    "Are you leaving?" Tong Yu asked.

    Huo Fang took off his clothes.

    Tong Yu opened his eyes wide, so direct?

    He walked to the cloakroom, took out a black shirt and put it on again.

    "Go out later." Huo Fang walked up to her and said, "Button it up for me."

    Tong Yu looked at him without moving.

    Huo Fang was not in a hurry, "They are waiting for me outside."

    When Tong Yu heard this, he immediately stood up and raised his hands to help him button the buttons.

    Huo Fang couldn't help but approach her, which was completely different from the feeling when Zhao Yike approached him.

    He had thought about her many times outside just now.

    Tong Yu listened to his breathing. They were both wearing clothes, but they had the illusion that they were exuding heat from each other.

    "Okay."

    Tong Yu couldn't retreat, because there was a bed behind him.

    Huo Fang raised his hand and caressed her face, "Wait for me."

    Tong Yu did not agree, nor did he say no wait.

    Huo Fang walked out of the bedroom again. This time the door was not closed tightly. He deliberately left it ajar.

    "Gone."

    Tong Yu didn't know whether he was telling her or someone outside.

    She didn't know they were gone until she heard the sound of the door closing outside.

    Tong Yu walked out, and the empty house seemed deserted now.

    She was a little hungry, it wasn't familiar here, and she didn't just rummage around.

    Going into the bathroom, she was looking for her clothes.

    There was nothing in the dirty clothes basket. She didn't believe that someone at home could take her clothes out of this place.

    Sure enough, I saw it in the washing machine.

    She quickly took it out, put it on, and hurried out.

    It's hard to get in, but easy to get out.

    It was a bit far from where she lived, so she ate something outside and took a taxi back home.
